name: Roc

source.note: Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual roc; the 2024 block isn't entered yet. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. The Restrained condition that comes with the Talons' grab is text only (the engine can't end it with the grapple).

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.summary: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Makes one Beak attack and one Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.summary: A tearing beak strike with 10 ft reach.

actions.name: Talons
actions.summary: Rakes and seizes a target (escape DC 19).
actions.text: The grabbed target is also Restrained while held, and the roc can't use its talons on anyone else.

summary: A bird the size of a ship: a tearing beak and talons that snatch prey away.
